issues: Console warning Recharts: width(-1)/height(-1) when chart container is mounted while hidden (cosmetic, no functional impact)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1483 lines — consider splitting into routers (imports/, reports/, properties/) per single-responsibility. Not blocking but maintenance-impacting.
On login the frontend redirects to '/' instead of '/dashboard' — both work (Dashboard mounts at root), but inconsistent with the documented spec. Low priority.

GET /api/report/{id}.{fmt}: when fmt is unsupported (e.g. xml), error is returned BEFORE looking up report_id — so /api/report/unknownReport.xml returns 400 ('Formato non supportato') instead of 404. Per the test spec, unknownReportId.pdf → 404 (works) and patrimonio.xml → 400 (works). All acceptance criteria met but the ordering is worth noting.
Report.jsx 'patrimonio-pdf' / 'bilancio-pdf' data-testids appear twice (top AI banner buttons + grid card buttons) — Playwright .first() handles it, but unique testids per location would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing seeded data (2 bilanci: Gennaio 2026 provvisorio + Dicembre 2025 definitivo; 0 movimenti bancari currently in DB for this user).
